separation_controls: The Singular source imports no project module and invokes no Python algebra.
The Lean source imports Mathlib but no project checker or generated CAS expression.
The Singular locus table and Lean theorem list are parsed against this protocol.
Source hashes and engine identities are recorded in the receipt.
negative_controls: Reject a rehashed receipt with a changed survivor locus.
Reject a rehashed receipt with a weakened claim boundary.
Reject missing Lean theorem declarations or any failed kernel check.
claim_boundary: Second-engine internal assurance: Singular checks the bounded m=2..32 elimination loci and Lean checks the displayed local algebraic implications. This does not formalise the all-m coefficient-extraction proof, monodromy/scaling lemma, finite-pole descent, inherited primitive audit, or rank-preserving extension theorem; it is not external independent reproduction.
